name: Atheism
line: Atheists are people who do not believe in any gods.
summary: American Atheists says an atheist is simply someone who lacks a belief in gods. Atheism is not a religion or a belief system. It answers one question: do you believe in gods? Beyond that, atheists do not share a holy book, a leader or a set of teachings, and they hold many different views, including on politics. Pew Research Center found that about three in four US atheists do not believe in God, a higher power or any spiritual force. Like most Americans, many atheists say they find meaning in family.
beliefs: They do not believe in any gods.
Atheism answers one question; it is not a full belief system.
Most US atheists do not believe in any higher power or spiritual force.
Atheists hold many different views about politics, ethics and life.
practices: Find meaning in family, friends and hobbies.
Some join local atheist, humanist or freethought groups.
Some work so nonreligious people are treated fairly.

followers.value: About 5% of US adults (Pew Research Center)
